svg.aria-label: Residual noise versus frequency for anti-noise that is late by 10, 25 or 50 microseconds. Cancellation is deep at low frequencies, falls to about minus 10 dB near 1 to 5 kilohertz, and above one over six tau the anti-noise increases the noise.
svg.text: Why ANC is a low-frequency tool
Residual noise when perfectly matched anti-noise arrives late by τ
above 0 dB the anti-noise makes it louder
